title: Prospective independent healthy-PBMC recombinant IFN-beta 6-hour validation

BN-PB-IV-003_C03.reason: GSE224351 lacks an explicit baseline-to-6-hour participant mapping and is below the locked non-pegylated paired-participant minimum

claim_boundary.target: donor-aware directional reproducibility of the frozen IFN-beta pseudobulk signature in a new independent healthy-PBMC 6-hour experiment
not_target: independence of assay platform from the discovery cohort

analysis_population.material: fresh or cryopreserved PBMC with one handling mode used for every donor
analysis_population.donor_context: healthy adult volunteers independent of GSE96583 and Parse-10M

cohorts.source: new data collection at an independent laboratory and donor pool
cohorts.vehicle_control: matched carrier and medium without IFN-beta
cohorts.paired_design: each donor PBMC preparation is split into IFN-beta and vehicle aliquots before incubation

identity_and_pairing_contract.authoritative_key: participant_id_hash exported from the source LIMS/consent registry before sequencing
identity_and_pairing_contract.pair_definition: two aliquots share the exact authoritative participant_id_hash and have distinct opaque arm IDs
identity_and_pairing_contract.missing_or_ambiguous_key_action: ABSTAIN; do not infer or repair a pair

experimental_randomization_and_blinding.aliquot_assignment: computer-randomized within donor to opaque ARM_A or ARM_B before stimulation
experimental_randomization_and_blinding.plate_position: blocked by donor and randomized within block
experimental_randomization_and_blinding.condition_key_repository_policy: the completed key must never be committed to this repository or included in the blinded packet
experimental_randomization_and_blinding.analysis_labels: opaque cohort, participant, aliquot, library, and arm identifiers
experimental_randomization_and_blinding.unblinding_boundary: only after preregistration, analysis code, input manifest, and blinded packet hashes are frozen and the independent biostatistician records them

locked_QC.doublet_method: Scrublet with software version and parameters recorded before condition-key release
locked_QC.sample_exclusion: only preregistered technical gates; no response-size or endpoint-dependent exclusion
locked_QC.donor_exclusion: if either arm fails, the donor is incomplete and the study ABSTAINS rather than inferring or replacing the pair after outcome access

donor_leave_one_out.role: carried frozen from predecessor; no refitting

platform_holdout.role: C02 context retained; not replaced by C04

matched_6h_holdout.metric: median paired-donor direction concordance for the frozen C01 top-100 genes in C04

multi_cohort.metric: fraction of frozen signature genes with consistent direction in C01, complete C02, and C04

negative_control.identity_assignment_handling: observed assignment excluded from null and included once by plus-one numerator_and_denominator

decision_policy.failed_endpoint: retain result and set status to negative_result
